name: OpenVPN Profiles
author: rmarchei
description: Manage multiple NetworkManager OpenVPN profiles from the Omarchy bar, with password, certificate, and certificate + password authentication backed by the system keyring.

barWidget.description: Connect and disconnect OpenVPN profiles using passwords, client certificates, or both.

schema.label: OpenVPN configuration directory
schema.description: Directory containing .ovpn or .conf files, directly or one folder deep. Files are imported into NetworkManager only when used.

schema.label: One connection at a time
schema.description: Disconnect other OpenVPN profiles before connecting a new one. Turn off to keep several profiles connected at once.
